rules: Use tight letter spacing (tracking-tight) for headings
Do not use generic sans for headings
Overlines and labels must be Uppercase, text-xs, tracking-[0.2em]

layout_and_spacing.mode: Mode B: The Control Room Grid

components.button: rounded-none font-mono uppercase text-sm tracking-wider px-6 py-2 transition-colors
components.button_danger: bg-transparent border border-[#FF3333] text-[#FF3333] hover:bg-[#FF3333] hover:text-white
components.badge: rounded-none px-2 py-0.5 text-xs font-mono border
components.chart: Recharts with monochrome/minimal styling. Grid lines should be very subtle (#27272A). Tooltips must have solid black backgrounds with 1px border.
components.logs_panel: bg-black text-[#A1A1AA] font-mono text-xs p-4 h-full overflow-y-auto border border-[#27272A]

icons.style: Regular or Duotone, geometric and clean

motion.hover: Instant color changes or minimal 150ms transitions. No bouncy scaling.
motion.logs: Smooth auto-scroll for new log entries.

testing.requirements: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute in kebab-case.

image_urls.description: Use as a heavily darkened (bg-black/80) background for the architecture diagram modal or header.

header.layout: Flex row, justify-between, items-center. border-b border-[#27272A]. bg-[#050505]
header.content: App title (JetBrains Mono, tracking-tighter), global connection status (pulsing dot), overall latency.

grid_layout.fleet_panel: col-span-12 lg:col-span-3. List of devices. Selected state gets a 1px blue border or background tint.
grid_layout.simulator_main: col-span-12 lg:col-span-6. Includes the big Edge vs Cloud toggle and the Network Disconnect button (Danger style).
grid_layout.model_repo: col-span-12 lg:col-span-3. List of models, deploy button.
grid_layout.metrics_charts: col-span-12 lg:col-span-8. Line charts for Latency and Cost. Small metric blocks (KPIs) above the charts.

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure the layout feels like a single pane of glass (Control Room Grid).
Use JetBrains Mono for all headings and data values to enforce the engineering/telemetry vibe.
Do not use border radius (rounded-none) anywhere to maintain the strict, rigid Swiss Brutalist aesthetic.
For the grid, you can use a flex/grid layout with strict 1px borders to separate widgets.
Implement the live simulation data via mock intervals in React (FPS, CPU, Mem, Latency).
When 'Simulate Network Disconnect' is active, transition Edge latency to spike and Cloud latency to show 'ERR', update logs with connection timeout errors.
Use Recharts for the metrics chart.
